feature: Dokumen pendukung wajib untuk FIN/Passport (DL, EP atau Passport, RA bila disewa) dan FIN/Passport selalu masuk review manual di cron approval
note: Ada validasi server dan UI untuk dokumen wajib pemegang FIN/Passport dan aturan approval yang menaruh FIN/Passport di pending. Ini bukan pengecekan live work pass (yang diminta OCMS42.18), jadi tidak diklaim oleh story yang saya terima; kemungkinan sudah tercakup story furnish lain (OCMS42.9, 42.12, 42.22) yang tidak saya trace.
note_en: There is server and UI validation for mandatory FIN/Passport holder documents and an approval rule that leaves FIN/Passport pending. This is not the live work pass check requested by OCMS42.18, so the stories given to me do not claim it; it is probably covered by other furnish stories (OCMS42.9, 42.12, 42.22) that I did not trace.
